data.gender_notes: Aneezah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'an'a meaning 'to be high-ranking or noble.' Aneezah refers to a graceful and sublime woman who is held in high esteem and respected for her righteousness and wisdom. The name Aneezah carries the meaning “Graceful, Sublime” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aneezah usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, sublime and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Aneezah bint Talha was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and is renowned for her courage and dedication during the Battle of Uhud. When the Muslim army was defeated, the enemy forces pursued the retreating Muslims. Aneezah, despite being pregnant, mounted her camel and fought bravely to protect the Prophet and the Muslim forces from being captured.

Aneezah bint Al-Harith was a prominent scholar and poetess in early Islam. She was known for her memorization and recitation of the Quran, and her poetry was filled with spiritual and moral themes. She is also believed to have been a teacher and a source of inspiration for many women in early Islamic society.

The name Aneezah is also featured in popular culture, with characters bearing this name appearing in various books, films, and television shows.
